item.title: Show HN: Snippety.app – macOS snippet manager I've been building for 6 years
item.summary: Snippety is my most important project - an advanced, 100% native text expander for Mac and iPhone. I originally started building it for myself, but over time I decided to make it useful for others too. I've really enjoyed working on this app, and in March I quit my job to take some time to rest and focus more on Snippety. Since then, I've added a lot of features, including a compact interface, conditional blocks, a CLI, and more. I've created and maintained this app from top to bottom all by myself :). Snippety is free to try, and I also offer a one-time purchase with lifetime updates. It's probably not the best business model for me, but I really dislike how everything has become subscription-based, so this is my small way of fighting that trend. :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49291244 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
